node56.overall: Main entrance of the Cadets Training Wing: a controlled gate under CCTV surveillance forming the sole vehicle/pedestrian chokepoint. A sentry post and guard structure flank the gate; a two-storey administrative building overlooks the entry. The interior opens onto a straight palm-lined avenue leading to the campus core.

front.summary: The main gate arch ('POWER THROUGH KNOWLEDGE') with an ornate swing metal gate to the right and a concrete guard structure to the left. A two-storey building stands just inside.

features.label: Main gate arch & metal gate
features.note: Ornate iron swing gate on the right; the single controlled entry/exit point

features.label: Guard structure (left of gate)
features.note: Low concrete box abutting the boundary wall; likely barrier/guard position

features.label: Two-storey building
features.note: Yellow building beyond the gate with multiple windows on both floors and a red roof; ground and first-floor windows overlook the entry

features.label: Boundary wall
features.note: Cream/red painted perimeter wall running left

features.label: Parked scooter
features.note: Two-wheeler parked against the left wall

front.cover: Gate pillars, the concrete guard box, and the boundary wall provide hard cover near the entrance
front.concealment: Trees and the wall corner cast shadow; shrubbery to the left offers light concealment
front.blindSpots: Area immediately behind the guard box and beyond the far side of the gate is not visible from this viewpoint
front.routes: The gate is the primary approach; road curves in past the pillars toward the interior
front.hazards: Gravel/rock landscaping bed at bottom-left (uneven footing); red-white kerb stones edging the road

right.summary: The 'Cadets Training Wing' rules board and a campus site-map board beside the internal road. Boundary wall runs along the left; a small single-storey hut sits at the far right.

features.label: CCTV / rules signboard
features.note: States 'You are under CCTV surveillance', 'prove your identity', 'enter details in the book kept with guard' - indicates active surveillance and a manned entry log

features.label: Site-map board
features.note: Painted layout of the Cadets Training Wing - a useful orientation reference

features.label: Small hut (far right)
features.note: Single-storey outbuilding at the tree line on the right

features.label: Boundary wall
features.note: Cream/red perimeter wall along the left of the internal road

right.cover: The signboards and the boundary wall offer hard cover; the hut provides cover on the right
right.concealment: Trees and potted-plant clusters give partial concealment along the road edge
right.blindSpots: Behind the site-map board and beyond the hut on the right is not observable here
right.routes: Internal road leads straight ahead into the campus from the gate
right.hazards: Rock-filled kerb beds and brick-edged planters intrude on the road margins

back.summary: The internal approach avenue leading away from the gate into the campus - a straight tarmac road lined with palms, with a building on the left and an Indian flag on a pole in the distance.

features.label: Internal avenue
features.note: Straight sealed road; the main axis into the campus - a natural movement corridor and long sightline

features.label: Single-storey building (left)
features.note: White structure set behind hedging; wall and roofline visible

features.label: Flagpole
features.note: National flag on a pole further down the avenue - an orientation landmark

features.label: Landscaped verges
features.note: Low white walls, hedges and shaped shrubs line both sides

back.cover: Low white boundary walls and the building corner on the left provide hard cover
back.concealment: Palm trunks and roadside hedging give intermittent concealment along the avenue
back.blindSpots: Dead ground behind the hedging and the left-hand building is hidden
back.routes: The avenue is the principal internal route from the gate toward the campus core
back.hazards: Direct sun down the avenue (glare on this bearing); paved/gravel verge transitions

left.summary: A sentry post - a small painted guard cabin with a window and doorway - set among palms and a large concrete barrier block beside the road.

features.label: Sentry post cabin
features.note: Small red-and-cream guard hut with a covered front, a window and a door facing the road - a manned observation/checkpoint position

features.label: Concrete barrier block
features.note: Large white cast block by the roadside; a vehicle barrier / hard cover

features.label: Palm & shade trees
features.note: Tall palms and a broad-canopy tree providing overhead shade and concealment

features.label: Lawn & buildings beyond
features.note: Open manicured lawn with single-storey buildings along the far edge

left.cover: The concrete barrier block and the sentry cabin walls are solid hard cover
left.concealment: Dense tree canopy and shadow give good concealment on this flank
left.blindSpots: The interior of the sentry cabin and ground behind the barrier block are not visible
left.routes: Road curves past the sentry post; the open lawn is crossable but exposed
left.hazards: Rock-filled kerb beds around the tree bases; the barrier block narrows the road margin

up.summary: Clear open sky with tree canopy intruding at the edges; no structures or overhead features of note.

features.label: Tree canopy
features.note: Palm and broadleaf crowns frame the upper edges

up.concealment: Overhead canopy offers concealment from aerial observation at the edges

down.summary: Sealed tarmac road surface at the junction in front of the gate, with painted lane markings and the photographer's shadow; kerb and gravel beds at the margins.

features.label: Road junction
features.note: Tarmac surface where the approach meets the gate; painted white lane lines

features.label: Kerb & gravel beds
features.note: Red-white kerb stones and decorative rock beds at the road edges

down.routes: Road surface is open and trafficable in all directions at this junction
down.hazards: Loose gravel beds at the margins; kerb stones are a trip/vehicle hazard
